summary: Iteration 11 review of BLOXGRADE gold-promo + public-profile + wide live-feed features. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11.py (10 tests, 9 pass) covering POST /api/promo/apply (case-insensitive XYIPACHOSIK -> 0.067 + gold_nick, SINZUKU -> 0.10 with gold_nick false for a fresh user, unknown code 400, 401 without JWT), GET /api/live-drops enrichment (avatar/discord_id/gold_nick, limit clamp) and GET /api/users/{discord_id} (full payload, stats, best_drop correctness, no balance exposure, 404 for unknown). Frontend: Playwright on the public URL with JWT in localStorage - live-drop-feed is exactly 210px, no-scrollbar, wheel-scrollable (scrollTop 0->400); hover animation verified via computed styles (user face opacity 1 / transform none, item face opacity 0 / translateY(-110%)), live-drop-nickname='Tester' data-gold='true'; card click -> /users/1 and public-profile-page with all stat blocks, id, copy-link; /users/doesnotexist -> public-profile-error 'Игрок не найден'; /profile gold nick + profile-gold-badge + profile-copy-link copies full URL; header profile-nickname gold and menu-public-profile-link -> /users/1; mobile (390px) live-drop-strip renders with the same clickable cards and sidebar hidden. Only real defects found are a stale/empty promo input on /profile and public exposure of internal session_id in drop payloads.

minor.issue: Public responses expose internal session_id because the Drop model is returned as-is (drops[] and best_drop each contain session_id: 'discord_test_1'). Should be excluded from public payloads (response_model_exclude or a PublicDrop model). Test test_drops_have_no_session_id_leak fails on this.

ui_bugs.issue: Applied promo code is not shown on /profile: input renders empty with placeholder 'Введите промокод' although user has XYIPACHOSIK. Cause: useState(authUser?.promo_code) initialises before authUser resolves and is never re-synced (no useEffect). Inside TopUpModal it works (mounts later) and correctly shows 'XYIPACHOSIK' + '+6,7% К ДЕПОЗИТУ'.

Requested '+6,7% к депозиту' text is NOT visible on /profile - the promo-bonus banner is gated behind !compact, and ProfilePage passes compact. Verified correct (+6,7%, not rounded to 7%) only in the top-up modal.

action_items: Exclude session_id from public drop payloads in GET /api/users/{discord_id} and GET /api/live-drops.
Sync PromoInput local state with authUser.promo_code via useEffect so /profile shows the active code (green check state).
Decide whether the '+6,7% к депозиту' banner should also render in the compact /profile PromoInput (spec asked for it there).
critical_code_review_comments: Drop pydantic model is reused for public endpoints; introduce a public projection instead of leaking session_id.
PromoInput derives state from props/context only at mount - classic stale-initial-state bug; use useEffect or key the component on authUser?.promo_code.
public_profile() loads up to 5000 upgrades and 5000 withdrawn history docs per request just to count them; use count_documents/aggregation to avoid O(n) payloads as users grow.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created Mongo user session_id 'discord_test_2' (discord_id '2', Tester2) for the SINZUKU regression check; deleted afterwards along with its drops (verified 0 docs). discord_test_1 untouched except promo re-apply (already XYIPACHOSIK). No other users, bank or upgrades touched; reset_all.py NOT run.
test_credentials: JWT minted for session_id discord_test_1 per /app/memory/test_credentials.md; localStorage key 'bloxgrade_token'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11.py (requires discord_test_1 with 3 skins + >=8 drops; creates/deletes discord_test_2 itself). Note pytest.ini runs xdist loadscope - do not pass -n/-p no:xdist. Live feed sidebar offsetWidth(210)-clientWidth(209)=1px is the right border, not a scrollbar. Site is LIVE: never run reset_all.py.
rca_of_the_issue: Empty promo field on /profile: PromoInput calls useState(authUser?.promo_code || '') on first render, when useAuth has not yet resolved /api/auth/me, so the initial value is '' and no effect re-syncs it; TopUpModal mounts on demand after auth resolves, hence it displays the code correctly. session_id leak: public endpoints serialize the full internal Drop model.
